name: Global Shitty List Integration
description: Shows Global Shitty List positions in level search and syncs with globalshittylist.com

rank-names.name: Rank names
rank-names.description: How list positions are written: <cy>Short</c> = #1 CL, <cy>Full</c> = #1 Classic.

replace-face.name: Replace difficulty face
replace-face.description: Show the demon face and difficulty from the list instead of the in-game one. Turn off to keep the real in-game difficulty.

show-rate.name: Show list rate
show-rate.description: Show the level's <cy>rate</c> from the Global Shitty List (Featured, Epic, Legendary, Mythic) as the frame around the difficulty face, and as text on the level page.

trim-song-name.name: Shorten song name
trim-song-name.description: Shrink long song names in level search so they don't go over the level preview.

default-list.name: Default list
default-list.description: Which list opens first on the GSL screen.

search-bar-mode.name: Search bar
search-bar-mode.description:
<cy>Hide on scroll</c> — the search bar hides when you scroll down, a small arrow opens and closes it.
<cy>Arrow only</c> — hidden until you press the arrow.
<cy>Always shown</c> — always visible, no arrow.

show-gsl-button.name: Show GSL button
show-gsl-button.description: Show the round GSL button in the level search screen. <cr>Without it the GSL screen can't be opened.</c>

hidden-button-reminder.name: Remind when button is hidden
hidden-button-reminder.description: When the GSL button is hidden, show a reminder on every game start that it needs to be turned on.

bg-blur.name: Background blur
bg-blur.description: How much the level screenshots behind the list are blurred. <cy>0</c> = sharp.

bg-darken.name: Background darkening (%)
bg-darken.description: How much the level screenshots are darkened so the list is easier to read. <cy>0</c> = original brightness.

bg-interval.name: Background change (seconds)
bg-interval.description: How often the background screenshot changes.

poll-interval.name: Check interval (seconds)
poll-interval.description: How often to check the site for changes

notify-updates.name: Notify about list updates
notify-updates.description: Show a notification in game when the Global Shitty List changes on the site.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: On game start, check if a new version of the mod is out and offer to install it in one click.
